Every Unix-like operating system uses th.why: Stated as a rule about the class (Wikipedia's path article: Unix introduced the slash, and its table gives "/" for Unix and Unix-like systems), and in very many programming texts contrasting Unix-like systems with Windows. Rated unlikely rather than very_unlikely because a model could also generalise it from members (Linux, macOS).
